title: Zimri (king of Israel)
summary: King of the northern kingdom of Israel. Jones dates a reign of 7 days. Not Zimri-Lim.
description: King of the northern kingdom of Israel. Jones dates a reign of 7 days. Not Zimri-Lim. Appendix F prints no end year, so no span is stored.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year.

standby.note: Standby placement only. Ussher-Jones (Floyd Nolen Jones, The Chronology of the Old Testament) prints this BC/AD year on the reign entry (3075 929 Zimri reigns over Israel for 7 days). It is not a sort year. No Anno Mundi, regnal length, or Julian Period figure was converted to obtain it.

reign.date: 3075 929 Zimri reigns over Israel for 7 days
reign.citation: Jones, The Chronology of the Old Testament: A Return to the Basics, 23rd ed. (Master Books, 2026), Appendix F, printed p. 279 (PDF p. 314)
reign.note: Jones prints a reign of 7 days. Appendix F prints no end year, so no span is stored.
